stories.title: Michigan residents to hear power, jobs, tax details at August data center session
stories.dek: The session will outline a proposed data center project and its local impacts. Michigan residents near the site may face questions about power use, jobs, and tax effects. The event gives the public a direct chance to hear details before decisions advance.
stories.source_title: PNK Group, former NYC mayor to host Aug. 1 data center meeting - Daily Tribune Media

stories.title: Council hopeful wants power-grid pause to block server farms until rural impact known
stories.dek: A council hopeful wants to halt data center proposals until impacts on power and land are clearer. Voters in the county will weigh whether the pause protects rural resources or slows economic growth. The stance could shape the race and future zoning fights.
stories.source_title: St. Joseph County Council candidate calls for moratorium on data centers - 95.3 MNC

stories.title: Tech giants seek approval to dump treated water from Michigan facility into river
stories.dek: The companies behind a massive proposed data center near Saline have filed for a state permit to release treated wastewater directly into the river. Residents downstream could see changes in water quality and flow if the discharge is approved. The filing puts a concrete environmental price tag on the project that has already drawn local scrutiny over power and land use.
stories.source_title: OpenAI, Oracle data center seeks permit to discharge wastewater into Saline River - MLive.com

stories.title: Saline data center backers funded Haley Stevens
stories.dek: Executives tied to the controversial Saline project donated to the congresswoman's campaign. Residents near the proposed site may see tax breaks or power strain tied to the same players. The donations raise questions about local influence in Washtenaw County.
stories.source_title: Executives Behind Controversial Saline Data Center Donated to Haley Stevens - Michigan Enjoyer

stories.title: Court rules in Shelby data center annexation fight
stories.dek: A judge has issued a decision on whether the site can bypass county oversight. Macomb County residents now face clearer rules on how future projects can be approved. The outcome affects local control and potential tax revenue.
stories.source_title: Court issues judgement in data center annexation case - Shelby News

stories.title: Hyperscale cashes out Bitcoin to bankroll Michigan AI campus
stories.dek: The company sold 100 BTC to speed construction of its planned Michigan AI data center. Residents near the site will see new power lines and tax questions tied directly to the project. The move shows how crypto holdings are now financing local data-center growth.
stories.source_title: Hyperscale Data sells 100 Bitcoin to fund AI data center buildout in Michigan - Crypto Briefing

stories.title: Cass County residents organize to shape future data center rules
stories.dek: Local groups are preparing to push zoning changes before more proposals land. The moves follow the Dowagiac project and aim to protect farmland and quiet roads. County decisions will decide how much industrial load the area accepts.
stories.source_title: Residents prepare to act on future data center proposals in Cass County - WSBT

stories.title: Walberg flags robotics job risks tied to Dowagiac data center
stories.dek: U.S. Rep. Tim Walberg is raising alarms over potential robotics work linked to a planned data center in Dowagiac. The warning comes as residents weigh local job gains against automation concerns. Cass County voters will track how the project affects employment and training needs.
stories.source_title: Walberg warns about robotics work tied to Dowagiac data center - Moody on the Market

stories.title: St. Joseph candidate pushes moratorium to block data centers
stories.dek: A candidate for St. Joseph County Council is calling for a temporary halt on data-center proposals. Residents would face sudden spikes in power bills and water use if large facilities arrive without local rules. The push comes as other Michigan counties scramble to write their own limits before projects land.
stories.source_title: St. Joseph County Council candidate calls for data center moratorium - WNDU

stories.title: Township leaders threatened as data center land battle explodes online
stories.dek: A viral clip sparked threats against township leaders weighing a data center proposal. The episode shows how raw local fights over power use and land are getting. Officials must still decide on the project amid the backlash.
stories.source_title: Tyrone Twp. officials face death threats after viral data center clip - Livingston Daily

stories.title: Mason County residents push back on data center plans
stories.dek: A commission heard from opponents and the public on a proposed center's power and land impacts. Local pushback could force changes or delays to the project. The hearing gives residents a direct say before bigger decisions.
stories.source_title: Mason County Commission hears presentation from data center opponent, and public comments - WV News

national.title: Data centers advance rapidly as regulators scramble for rules
national.dek: Across the U.S., officials race to impose guardrails on power-hungry facilities while communities push back on incentives and impacts.
